Status: The user accepted the proposed bounded D07 product requirement on 2026-10-27. This records product scope, not code/test completion.

One user intent spanning multiple canonical Operations must either:

- commit as one coherent local Runtime/Scene result and create exactly one user-visible Undo unit; or
- fail before canonical mutation and create no successful History entry.

Scope includes local Runtime/Scene/History observers. It excludes crash-atomic persistence, cross-client atomic visibility, distributed transactions and a canonical global Transaction.

Required: preflight all forward operations; construct inverses/preimages; reserve HistoryGroup/UndoIntent and required post-commit memory before mutation; serialize local commit/publication; preserve operation identities and semantic validation; one Undo unit on success; exact-target Undo and fresh-identity Redo; failure leaves Document, Scene/index publication, History cursor and redo branch unchanged.

Forbidden: global Transaction, new wire semantics, new ObjectKind/FieldId/OperationKind/public ABI/global registry, D06-B closure, weakened/deleted tests, cross-client/crash guarantees.

Evidence supplied by execution owner:

- baseline branch codex/selection-summary-batch3, SHA c7f874395d55952e9d5288e2a336a21747f37f11
- audit branch codex/fc04-d07-selection-audit, reported result commit e02fb7b8601bd01be968dbfb6aa783cfb3027e25
- 160 selection regressions passed; D07 11 passed and 3 failed.
- local report and commands: C:/Users/Chado/.codex/worktrees/selection-unified-batch1/canvas/.aegis/results/FC04-D07-AUDIT/[report.md](http://report.md) and commands.json.

Before any code change, Codex must verify the actual local HEAD, branch, report and commands. The exact three failing test IDs must be copied from those files. This connected review did not independently access the local C: paths or resolve the reported local commit remotely.

The owning P23/History Authority record must link this user acceptance and supersede only the prior OPEN D07 statement for this bounded scope. Do not claim the entire FC-00X-C contract is accepted. D06-B remains separate and OPEN.

Exit: original 3 failed checks pass; 11 D07 passes remain; all 160 selection regressions pass; failure-injection tests prove no partial visible mutation and no missing History unit; exact commands, exit codes, logs, revision and hashes are preserved.

No source changes or tests are claimed by this record.
